def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    a = [int(x) for x in data[2:2 + n]]

    if k <= n - k:
        m = k
        root = 0
        B = a
    else:
        m = n - k
        t = 0
        for v in a:
            t ^= v
        root = t
        B = a

    best = [-1]
    N = len(B)

    sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)

    def dfs(start, depth, x):
        if depth == m:
            if x > best[0]:
                best[0] = x
            return
        last = N - (m - depth)
        for i in range(start, last + 1):
            dfs(i + 1, depth + 1, x ^ B[i])

    dfs(0, 0, root)
    print(best[0])

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0]); k = int(data[1])
    A = [int(x) for x in data[2:2+n]]
    T = 0
    for a in A:
        T ^= a
    if k > n - k:
        m = n - k
        start = T
    else:
        m = k
        start = 0
    idxs = [-1]
    xs = [0]
    for _ in range(m):
        new_idx = []
        new_x = []
        for id_, x in zip(idxs, xs):
            r = range(id_ + 1, n)
            new_idx.extend(r)
            new_x.extend([x ^ A[i] for i in r])
        idxs = new_idx
        xs = new_x
    best = 0
    for x in xs:
        v = start ^ x
        if v > best:
            best = v
    print(best)
